title: The Creature That Edits the Message, Not the Code: The Octopus
summary: Explains how the octopus, squid and cuttlefish leave their DNA untouched and instead use the ADAR enzyme to change single letters (A→I) in the RNA messages leaving the cell, rewriting protein sequences at tens of thousands of points; it covers how brain proteins are retuned within hours as the water cools, and how the genome has been evolutionarily frozen in return for that flexibility.
